provenance.notes: Layout added 2026-11-17 by @vprusso: bilayer coordinates with interaction radius 2.2361 (research/local2d/layout_sweep.py, screen stage).

circuit.notes: Generic sequential two-block extraction: one ancilla per check, X checks then Z checks each round with joint reset and measurement layers; CX layers are a proper edge coloring of each Tanner graph (5 X + 5 Z CX layers per round, coloring candidate 1); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)

contributed_by.method: torus_grid.py: the two-block index convention read off as a Z_2 x Z_3 grid, one qubit of each block per site, no search; radius measured with the verifier's rule (research/local2d/layout_sweep.py)
